title: GOD'S THOUGHTS
FOR YOUR MORNING
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: soft morning golden hour sunrise light over peaceful misty meadow
dawn sunlight breaking over calm lake waters and hills
golden sunlight illuminating calm ocean beach sand at dawn
open sunlit window looking out at gentle morning forest fog
morning sky filled with soft golden clouds at sunrise
serene mountain horizon bathed in warm morning light

scenes.a: If you woke up feeling forgotten in a room full of unanswered questions, listen closely.
How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
Heavenly Father, before the heavy worries of today steal my peace, anchor my soul in your boundless grace.
You have not forgotten me; your mind is filled with thoughts of peace toward my life. I walk forward knowing I am never alone.
Amen. Subscribe to The Morning Altar to pray together every sunrise.
